messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Restored arrow key navigation. Unmodified arrow keys move one card left, right, up, or down, and stop at board edges. Focus stays on the remembered card; modifier combinations and Enter/Space keep their existing browser behavior.

The change is in [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx:57), [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:7), and [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx:30). Tests were not run.
